# Read Primitives — Simple Aggregation

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Aggregate over all rows in table

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* Aggregate over all rows in table */
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
  SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_revenue
FROM orders
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def aggregation_simple_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Aggregate over all rows in table."""
    col = ctx.col
    return ctx.get_table("orders").select(
        col("o_orderkey").count().alias("total_orders"), col("o_totalprice").sum().alias("total_revenue")
    )
```
